PotatoOrNot.Title: Potato Or Not
PotatoOrNot.BadDescription: If you have a laptop or a low end computer, use this setting for the best experience!
PotatoOrNot.MediumDescription: You have a mid-range computer that isn't bad, but it's getting on its years.
PotatoOrNot.GoodDescription: Your computer is squarely in the PCMR club.
PotatoOrNot.PlayerCheck.MenuHint: See whether Potato Or Not is running for each player and which setting they picked.
PotatoOrNot.PlayerCheck.Title: Potato Or Not: Player Check
PotatoOrNot.PlayerCheck.Intro: Each player shows up here once they've logged in with Potato Or Not running. This updates live.
PotatoOrNot.PlayerCheck.OutdatedHint: This player last loaded an older version of Potato Or Not.
PotatoOrNot.PlayerCheck.AskAgainHint: Players who are online see the potato prompt right away; everyone else sees it next time they log in.
PotatoOrNot.PlayerCheck.AskedAgain: Potato prompt sent. Online players will see it now, others on their next login.
